## Prospective PhD students

Applications go through the [programme name] at [University]; the deadline is
[date]. Email before you apply so we can talk about fit — include a paragraph on
what you want to work on and why, plus your CV.

[Open position / no funded position right now, but happy to support fellowship

## Undergraduates

We take [number] students each term for [project type]. Email with your CV, a

::: {.panel}
**Writing to us**

Send one email to <you@university.edu> with the subject line `Lab enquiry —
[your name]`. Tell us what you want to work on rather than what you have done;
the CV covers the second part. We reply to everyone, usually within a week.
:::

We particularly encourage applications from people underrepresented in [field].
If a formal requirement is a barrier for you, say so — it is often negotiable.
